title: 第120章

第(1/3)页

不过京城的岁月静好也只是暂时的平静。

北地一直还有二州没有收复。可惜眼下入秋农忙,并非用兵的好时节。而且大魏内政未稳，边关不宜再发生战事，这二州的收复也只能放缓一下。

好在铁弗人已经被打得大举北迁,现在北地相对安定，那些牧民们也可以安心度日,就连送入宫中的羊也格外肥美。

宗皇后被关在佛堂月余，连带着还要吃斋，现在好不容易出来了,再吃起梁州特产的黑毛羊来，顿时觉得眼角发酸。

她咽下了口里的羊肉，对着陪着她吃饭的儿媳妇和女儿发出一声感慨：“人人都喜欢来京城，可京城有什么好的？还是不如我们梁州,这老家的肉也香，那时跟各府夫人们说说话，打打花牌,也没有什么拘束……唉,我们什么时候能再回梁州啊……”

落云和韩瑶都是闷头吃饭,才能忍住要溢出来的笑。

因为宗皇后此时的哀叹，跟她在梁州思念京城的腔调是一模一样的。

落云低头忍了又忍,直到脸上的笑意忍住了，这才抬头道：“母后喜欢吃，就多吃点,还有几只老家送来的活羊,被圈起养着了。等入冬下雪了,支起热锅子涮肉片吃才好呢。”

宗皇后又叹了一口气说：“那敢情好,就是不知道宫里的厨子能不能调配出梁州辣子的蘸汁味道来……我这顿罚,也算是冤案。这事实证明,那个竣国公夫人的确不是什么好人，还好意思跳河？也不怕脏了内河的水，害得我这顿吃斋，等看到你们父皇，定要好好论道一番。”

这次不必落云劝，韩瑶先说话了，她一边替母后夹肉一边道：“我的好母后啊，您可别再去招惹父皇了。以前我们府门子窄，您和父皇关起门吵，谁也不知道。可现在这是皇宫大内，父皇也是九五至尊，您再大事小情地去烦父皇，岂不是给自己找不痛快？”

宗皇后瞪了女儿一眼，却也知道她说得在理，不由得再次叹了一口气，幽幽道：“那周嬷嬷顶天的给我讲课，我听都听饱了，还需你这黄毛的丫头来教训我？”

说到这，她似乎想起了什么，看向了落云，装似不经意地问：“算起来，我们来京这么久了，不知你娘家有没有来人谒见？”

落云老实回道：“我父亲起先躲避战乱回老家了，好像前几日才回京了，不过我还没得空见他……”

宗皇后一听，立刻教训道：“你如今怀着身孕，在宫里静心养胎，有什么可忙的？竟然摆谱说没空见自己的父亲！就算你如今贵为太子妃，可是依旧为人子女，不能不孝。哪里得空了，你让你父亲入宫，本宫也得见见亲家，周全了礼数。”

落云微微想了想，便猜到了婆婆突然热衷于敦促亲家亲情的缘故了。

最近宗家人也进京讨封了。

毕竟家里的女儿有了出息，成为一国的皇后，他们宗家也一夕之间，从辞官的罪臣，变成了显赫一时的外戚，自然也急着沾沾好处。

但是宗皇后当时被罚在佛堂修身，不得见面。

现在她虽然出来了，大概也清楚陛下对宗家的观感，毕竟当初为了给岳父堵窟窿，全家人节衣缩食地过得辛苦。

若是只给宗家讨封，宗氏有些不好说出口。可是若拉上儿媳妇的父亲一家，陛下总不好连他爱宠的太子面子也不给吧？

到时候，宗家和苏家一起讨封，也不算厚此薄彼。

落云想明白了宗皇后的打算，便开口说道：“母后可能不知我父亲的为人，倒是跟宗家的祖父……有些相似，看到钱财就忘了瞻前顾后，全然不考虑儿女的难处。我的确是故意摆谱，缓缓再见他，也让他心里有个数。虽然临风现在贵为太子，却也要注意自己的言行，不被谏官抓到错处。若是父亲以为自己贵为外戚，就能予取予求，给我出些难应付的题目，给父皇和太子带来恶名，我是第一个就不能容他的。”

宗皇后听了这话，脸颊隐隐发烫。儿媳妇虽然张嘴点出了她父亲宗庆贪财的本性，可她却不好发作。

因为人家落云是连着自己的父亲一同骂的，而且落云说得又是事实，就连宗王妃自己都得承认，宗庆若论贪财，可算是个中翘楚。

落云假装没看到婆婆的窘态，又继续说道：“如今太子正帮助父皇推行土改新政，许多手里握着土地的豪绅地主，都想要求情让自己领些特权。不巧我父亲的名下田产也不少，我这个时候见，他若开口求，我应不应都不对，不如借故不见，等过了这阵子再说。”

落云说得这么直白，其实就是要敲打一下她的这位婆婆。

跟宗家的田产相比，苏鸿蒙的田产不过九牛一毛。

依着宗庆的人品，以前也定然不会如实上报田地亩数，现在他领着儿子急火火地要来见宗皇后，只怕就是想求宗皇后赦免田税。

现在陛下和世家们因为均田的的事情，都已经斗成了乌眼青。满朝的世家旧贵都想要抓太子和陛下的把柄。

若是这个节骨眼，皇后再提这么非分的要求，陛下定然不会答应，这对积年恩怨的夫妻再吵，宗氏毫无优势可言，只能再去佛堂吃斋。

不过她作为儿媳妇，有些话也只能点到为止，听不听，全在自己了。

那日落云和韩瑶走后，盛妈妈拿了几件衣服，问皇后，下午召见宗家老爷时，皇后打算穿哪件。

宗皇后心烦意乱地搓了搓手里的那串佛珠子，想想儿媳妇方才说过的话，最后厌烦得挥了挥手道：“让宫人去传话，就说我在佛堂里染了风寒，有些病沉，不宜见客，让他们且先回去，何时能见了，我再宣召他们！”

盛妈妈一听，迟疑道：“这……不太好吧？宗老爷可是等您甚久，好不容易等到了您出佛堂，听宗家大爷的话，他老人家最近思女心切，身子骨也不大好了……”

宗皇后一瞪眼：“你也知我刚出佛堂，难道还要陪我再进去？让你传话，你就快些，哪里有那么多废话！”

看宗皇后动怒，盛妈妈不敢再言，可惜她收了那宗家父子几十两银子的好处，看来这次是帮衬着说不上话了。

宗皇后看盛妈妈低头退下后，望着窗外的瑟瑟落叶，又是幽幽叹气：“还是梁州好，想见谁就见谁……”

Page (1/3)

However, the peaceful years in the capital are only temporary.

There are still two states in the North that have not been recovered.Unfortunately, now that autumn is busy with farming, it is not a good time to use troops.Moreover, the internal affairs of the Wei Dynasty were not stable, and it was not suitable for further wars at the border. The recovery of these two states could only be slowed down.

Fortunately, the Tiefu people have been beaten and moved northward in large numbers. Now the north is relatively stable, and the herdsmen can live in peace. Even the sheep sent to the palace are especially fat.

Empress Zong was imprisoned in the Buddhist hall for more than a month and had to fast. Now she finally came out. When she ate the black sheep, a specialty of Liangzhou, she suddenly felt sore at the corners of her eyes.

She swallowed the mutton in her mouth and sighed to her daughter-in-law and daughter who were dining with her: "Everyone likes to come to the capital, but what's so good about the capital? It's still not as good as ours in Liangzhou. The meat in my hometown is also delicious. At that time, I could talk to the ladies from various provinces and play flower cards without any restrictions... Well, when can we go back to Liangzhou..."

Luo Yun and Han Yao both ate with their heads down, unable to hold back the laughter that was about to overflow.

Because Empress Zong's lament at this time was exactly the same as the way she missed the capital in Liangzhou.

Luo Yun lowered his head and endured it again and again, until the smile on his face stopped, and then he raised his head and said, "If your mother likes to eat, just eat more. There are also a few live sheep sent from her hometown, which are being raised in pens. When it snows in winter, it will be better to put up a hot pot and cook the meat slices."

Empress Zong sighed again and said: "That's good, but I don't know if the cooks in the palace can prepare the flavor of Liangzhou spicy sauce... My punishment can be regarded as an unjust case. This fact proves that Mrs. Jun Guo is indeed not a good person, and she still has the nerve to jump into the river? She is not afraid of dirtying the water in the inland river and causing me to eat fast. When I see your father, I will have a good discussion."

There was no need for Luo Yun to persuade her this time. Han Yao spoke first. She took the meat for her mother and said, "My good queen, please don't provoke your father anymore. In the past, our house was narrow, and you and your father quarreled behind closed doors, and no one knew about it. But now this is the palace, and your father is also the Supreme Being. If you continue to bother your father with big and small things, won't you be causing trouble for yourself?"

Empress Zong glared at her daughter, but she also knew that what she said was reasonable. She couldn't help but sigh again and said quietly: "Nanny Zhou gave me a lecture with all her might, and I was tired of listening to it. Do you still need a yellow-haired girl like you to teach me a lesson?"

Speaking of this, she seemed to have remembered something, looked at Luoyun, and asked casually: "After all, we have been in Beijing for so long. I wonder if anyone from your mother's family has come to visit us?"

Luoyun replied honestly: "My father went back to his hometown to avoid the war. It seems he just returned to Beijing a few days ago, but I haven't had time to see him yet..."

When Empress Zong heard this, she immediately lectured: "You are pregnant now, and you are quietly raising the baby in the palace. What is there to do? You actually pretended that you had no time to see your father! Even though you are now the crown prince, you are still a child and must not be unfilial. Wherever you have time, if you let your father enter the palace, I must also meet my in-laws. I have followed all the etiquette."

Luoyun thought for a moment and guessed the reason why her mother-in-law was suddenly keen on promoting family ties.

Recently, the Zong family also went to Beijing to ask for a seal.

After all, the daughter of the family has made a career and has become the queen of a country. The family has also gone from a resigned minister to a prominent relative overnight. Naturally, they are eager to take advantage of it.

However, Empress Zong was punished to cultivate herself in the Buddhist hall and was not allowed to meet her.

Although she has come out now, she probably knows how His Majesty feels about the Zong family. After all, the whole family had to live frugally in order to plug the hole for her father-in-law.

If it were only for the Zong family to ask for a title, it would be difficult for the Zong family to express it.But if you involve your daughter-in-law's father's family, your Majesty can't even give face to his beloved prince, right?

At that time, if the Zong family and the Su family seek the title together, it will not be regarded as favoring one over the other.

Luoyun figured out Empress Zong's plan and said, "Mother may not know what my father is like, but she is somewhat similar to the grandfather of the Zong family. He forgets to look forward and backward when he sees money, and does not consider the difficulties of his children at all. I did deliberately put on a show, and seeing him slowly also made him feel sad.There is a clue.Although Linfeng is now the prince, he must be careful about his words and deeds so as not to be caught in the wrong by the admonishment officials.If my father thinks that he can ask for anything because he is a relative, I will not be able to tolerate him if he brings some difficult problems to my father and the prince."

After hearing this, Queen Zong's cheeks felt slightly hot.Although the daughter-in-law opened her mouth to point out her father Zong Qing's money-grubbing nature, she was not able to get angry.

Because Luo Yun scolded his father together, and what Luo Yun said was true, even Princess Zong herself had to admit that Zong Qingruo was one of the best when it came to being greedy for money.

Luo Yun pretended not to notice her mother-in-law's embarrassment, and continued: "Now the prince is helping his father to implement the land reform and new policies. Many gentry and landlords who hold the land want to ask for favors so that they can receive some privileges. Unfortunately, my father also has a lot of land in his name. If I meet him at this time, if he asks, I should not respond. I might as well excuse myself and wait until later."

Luoyun said it so bluntly, but actually she wanted to give her mother-in-law a beating.

Compared with the Zong family's land, Su Hongmeng's land is just a drop in the bucket.

According to Zong Qing's character, he would definitely not report the number of acres of land truthfully before. Now he and his son are eager to see Empress Zong, probably just to ask Empress Zong to forgive the land tax.

Now His Majesty and the aristocratic families are all at loggerheads over the matter of Juntian.All the noble families in the dynasty wanted to take advantage of the prince and his majesty.

If at this juncture, the Queen makes such an unreasonable request again, Your Majesty will definitely not agree. If this couple who have been grudged for many years quarrels again, the Zong family will have no advantage at all and can only go to the Buddhist hall to eat fast.

However, as a daughter-in-law, she can only say so much. Whether she listens to it or not is entirely up to her.

After Rui Yun and Han Yao left that day, Sheng's mother took some clothes and asked the queen which one she planned to wear when she summoned the master of the Zong family in the afternoon.

Empress Zong rubbed the string of Buddhist beads in her hand distractedly, thinking about what her daughter-in-law had just said, and finally waved her hands in boredom and said: "Let the palace people send a message. Just say that I caught a cold in the Buddhist hall, and I am seriously ill. It is not suitable to see guests. Let them go back first. I will summon them when I can see you!"

When Mother Sheng heard this, she hesitated and said, "Isn't this... not good? Mr. Zong has been waiting for you for a long time. He finally waited until you came out of the Buddhist hall. According to Mr. Zong's words, he has been missing his daughter recently and his health is not good..."

Empress Zong glared: "You also know that I have just left the Buddhist hall, why do you still want to accompany me back in? I asked you to pass on the message, so hurry up. There is so much nonsense!"

Seeing that Empress Zong was angry, Mother Sheng did not dare to say anything. Unfortunately, she received dozens of taels of silver from the Zong family and his son. It seemed that this time she was trying to help and could not speak.

Queen Zong watched Mother Sheng bow her head and retreat, then looked at the rustling fallen leaves outside the window, and sighed again: "It's better to go to Liangzhou, you can see whoever you want to see..."
